name: Carnegie

categories.label: VP on score track
categories.hint: Immediate VP already earned during play (score marker position).

categories.label: City connections
categories.hint: Up to 36 VP: network linking New York, Chicago, New Orleans, San Francisco; read from the board table using your lowest transport level.

categories.label: Unused Action Choice tile
categories.hint: 3 VP if you still have your Action Choice tile (3-4 players only).

categories.label: Active employees
categories.hint: 1 VP per active employee (not on Missions, not the permanent HR employee).

categories.label: Departments built (top row)
categories.hint: 3 VP per Department in the top row.

categories.label: Project tab VP
categories.hint: Sum across Housing (max 6), Commerce (max 9), Industry (max 12), Public Infrastructure (max 15).

categories.label: Construction projects
categories.hint: 0-3 VP per built project depending on its city.

categories.label: Donations
categories.hint: VP per donation disc (max 12 each, some bonuses raise it).

tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker: tied players share the victory.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Exact per-donation, per-city and project-tab tables are printed on the board/tabs, so they are entered as numbers rather than modelled. Any end-of-game money conversion was not confirmed. Solo game not modelled. Verified only from a RulesPal summary, not the official PDF.
